CustomField.description: The deal this loan finances. LOOKUP with required=false and deleteConstraint=SetNull, NOT required=true. A required lookup forces deleteConstraint=Restrict, which is precisely why Critical_Date__c makes its Transaction undeletable and why the seed scripts throw on a rebuilt org. Presence is enforced by the service that creates the record; if a hard rule is ever wanted use a validation rule, never the required flag, which would also make this field non-permissionable.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The deal this loan finances. Normally set automatically when the loan is created from the deal.
CustomField.label: Transaction
